pattern: reach a page several unknown menus deep -> preview_execute goal step, not a call per click
experience: Asked to click through a 10-screen settings maze in the T3 preview, the agent made one preview call per click, about 3 s a step, where a goal step takes about 0.3 s a step.
rule: preview_execute: goal lets a fast model click and scroll until the goal shows, for navigation whose next click depends on what appears
